title: Post-incident cost audit slate and callchain compact prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, shareable post-incident "audit slate" that surfaces alert metadata, SLO delta, estimated cost delta (tokens/GPU-hours), and a succinct callchain (on-call handoff timeline) to accelerate postmortem creation and cross-team handoff. The slate is intended to live in the incident sidebar and be exportable as a PDF/embed for compliance and billing review.
goals: Reduce time-to-postmortem by surfacing actionable incident context (alerts, SLO deltas, cost impact)
Provide Compact Callchain so responders can quickly see who was paged, who escalated, and the final owner
Make cost impact visible and linkable to billing dashboards to surface regression-related spend
Exportable artifact for auditors and executive summaries
success_metrics: Median time from incident close to postmortem draft < 48h
> 60% of incidents include exported audit slate in first 24h
Viewer click-through to billing console from slate > 15%
No accessibility regressions (WCAG AA) in slate components
decisions: Slate will prioritize snapshots over live controls; live controls remain in the incident console main view
Cost numbers are estimated at the 1h, 6h, and full-incident buckets; exact billing links will open billing console
Callchain uses compact avatars + role labels; we limit visible entries to 5 with expandable history to avoid visual noise
Export will be HTML->PDF using existing report generator to speed implementation
tradeoffs: Showing cost estimates in-slate may confuse legal/billing — mitigated by clear microcopy and link to official billing
Compact callchain reduces context; risk mitigated by one-click expand to full timeline
Exporting as PDF increases implementation effort for edge-case layout; accept narrower set of supported browsers for v1
accessibility_considerations: All visual indicators must have text equivalents (SLO delta arrows, cost trend icons)
Ensure color contrast for cost-up vs cost-down states (AA), avoid relying on color alone
Keyboard-first interactions for expand/collapse and export actions
notes_from_research: Interviewed 6 oncall engineers: common pain is stitching cost + SLO impact after the fact
Legal asked for an exportable snapshot that contains stable artifact links (PR, confluence) at time of export
Customer success wants a small embed for summary emails to customers post-incident
design_tasks: Finalize microcopy for cost disclaimer and export header
Polish compact callchain visual treatment (hover state shows escalation note)
Create responsive rules for mobile / narrow-pane rendering
Deliver Figma handoff tokens and component spec for engineering
